notes: Same corpus gap as torch-pipeline-parallelism: no task in the pool mentions torch.distributed, tensor parallelism, all_gather or all_reduce. I split transfer into (a) explicit weight-matrix/matmul-orientation work and hand-derived gradients, and (b) rank-partitioned computation, and ranked (a) higher here because the verifier checks sharding, outputs and gradients rather than a communication schedule. Retriever shortlists were dominated by generic 'ML data pipeline' TMax entries and, for TW/RTS, by pure shell-script boilerplate; nearly everything I kept came from my own searches. RTS is again the weakest corpus (its PyTorch content is a single torchmeter task, rts_task_956ea2e372fe004edbe0d44d; the rest is MPI hello-world and env setup), and its ranks 4-10 should be discounted at merge. Note the large overlap with my torch-pipeline-parallelism file — that is real, not an accident: the two TB tasks share a domain and the pool has only one small set of relevant tasks.
